analysis: Bounded source-geometry candidate only. The split changes vertex indices only and is independently re-audited against the pinned archive and source occupancy.

control.method: Pinned raw scan-001 voxel-boundary meshes for the same labels, source archive and affine.

method: CPU exact occupied-voxel-union triangles. Pair ordinary two-face edges by incidence, four-face contacts by source voxel owner, and accept an alternate pairing only if a unique single-edge change yields a globally closed two-manifold. Duplicate vertex indices only; preserve all coordinates, faces, winding, counts, areas and voxel occupancy.

predictions_before_source_run.geometry: Every selected mesh preserves its exact raw triangle-coordinate sequence, face count, winding, surface area, and signed voxel-occupancy volume.
predictions_before_source_run.independent_integrity: The separate auditor rechecks archive and NIfTI hashes, affine, voxel counts, serialized PLY indices and coordinates, source bounds, edge incidence, vertex links and occupancy volumes.
predictions_before_source_run.qualification_boundary: Scan-001 automatic segmentation geometry only; no expert segmentation accuracy, clinical anatomy, cross-scan registration, Numi subject binding, mechanics or physiology.
predictions_before_source_run.topology: All four selected surfaces will be closed two-manifolds after splitting; otherwise each unresolved surface remains a failed candidate.

purpose: Test the preregistered vertex-fan split on scan-001 Femur, Fibula, Patella and Tibia voxel-boundary surfaces; preserve exact source triangles and occupied voxels.
stopping_and_exclusion_rules: One scan-001 compile attempt for labels 15, 16, 20 and 30 under this exact plan.
Do not change, smooth, interpolate, decimate, or delete voxel-boundary triangles or occupied voxels.
If a contact is unsupported or has zero/multiple globally closed solutions, fail closed and retain that label as unresolved.
Any source identity, affine, voxel count, coordinate sequence, face count, area, volume, bounds, checksum or independent-audit failure invalidates the candidate.
A closed mesh is a topology result only; it does not establish segmentation accuracy, specimen identity, clinical validity, mechanical ownership, or whole-Human qualification.
